translation: Took place in posad Serock, 23 September 1890, 7 AM. Appeared personally Berek Kołtun, laborer, 65, and Majer Mendzilewski, shopkeeper, 25, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 4 AM died [corrected in red:] Elka Bobek, two years of age, born in posad [unclear: Serock], [red:] daughter of Gutman and [unclear: Estera], the Bobek spouses, [father's occupation unclear: shoemaker?]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of [closing left uncorrected:] Gutman Bobek, this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate. Red marginal note certifies the corrections.
